subject: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth sweetener
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie@clearline.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:21:00-08:00
Subject: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth package

Hi Julie — great call this morning. Quick recap and a proposal that should keep procurement moving while we complete the PoC validation:

Summary:
- Clearline PoC shows ~4.2x lift on entity extraction for invoices and 2.8x lift on routing accuracy.
- Usage is trending to 10M tokens/week at peak for a 45-day pilot window.

Proposal (we're requesting exec clearance):
1) 45-day trial extension (so the pilot runs through end of December)
2) $25,000 in promotional credits applied during the extended trial to cover token overages and prescriptive tuning
3) 50% discount on Q1 committed usage (up to $75k) with a 12-month conversion commitment if they hit the agreed adoption thresholds in the MAP

Why this matters:
- Clearline is a strategic logistics customer with strong cross-sell potential (TMS, routing, and later embeddings for search).
- Legal/procurement needs an updated SOW + clear pricing to meet their 11/12 procurement deadline.

I attached the PoC metrics sheet for reference (clearline-poc-metrics.xlsx). If you can sign to accept the above, procurement will route DocuSign the SOW this week.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm procurement timeline and whether legal needs any specific language around data residency?
- If you approve, I'll escalate internally for the promo/extension sign-off and share an updated SOW.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Attachment: clearline-poc-metrics.xlsx (spreadsheet - summary of PoC usage and KPIs)

From: Julie Park <julie@clearline.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearline.com>, Clearline Legal <legal@clearline.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth package

Thanks Aditya. Forwarding to procurement so they can loop in our sourcing/legal folks. Main asks from our side:
- Updated line-item SOW with the credit application mechanics (how credits are consumed/expired).
- Pricing breakdown showing the proposed Q1 discount and a sample invoice.
- Confirmation that audit logs and basic SOC evidence are available for the pilot.

Procurement, legal — our timeline is tight: target decision by 2027-11-12 to lock in calendar Q1 planning.

Julie Park
VP, Engineering (Data Platforms)
Clearline Logistics

Attachment: procurement-rfp.pdf (procurement requirements and timeline)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth package (exec approval request)

Neha / Laura — forwarding the customer reply. TL;DR: procurement needs an updated SOW and a decision by 11/12.

Quick context and business case (DL-7845):
- ARR potential: $250k first year if they convert; conservative 36-month CLTV ~ $600k with cross-sell.
- Current PoC momentum: production-like usage, strong product fit for routing and document parsing.
- Competitive pressure: they're also evaluating two vendors; flexible commercial sweetener is a conversion driver.

Requesting internal approval for the following concessions as an exception:
- Trial extension: 45 days (through Dec 31)
- Promotional credits: $25,000 to cover token overages and tuning support
- Introductory pricing: 50% discount on Q1 committed spend (capped at $75k)

Business justification: this is a strategic account in a sector we want to win (logistics) and it unlocks a referenceable enterprise with multiple potential product lines.

Attachments: deal-summary.pdf, MAL-approval-form.docx

Can you please confirm quickly whether we have authority to grant this? If not, what's the maximum credit/extension we can offer without needing Marissa?

Thanks — Aditya
(If faster, I can take a 10m call to walk through numbers.)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth package (exec approval request)

Aditya — thanks for the clean summary. I reviewed the PoC metrics and the pipeline notes. Recommendation on concessions:

- Approve promotional credits up to $20,000 (not $25k) — we need to preserve margin and also put a clear clawback if they do not convert within 90 days of paid conversion.
- Approve trial extension for 30 days autonomously. Anything beyond 30 days (i.e., 45 days) needs Marissa's signoff.
- The 50% Q1 discount is material; please escalate to Marissa. I suspect we can offer 25–30% at my level depending on procurement’s firm commitment.

Operational asks:
- Legal needs a clause for credit expiry and a revenue protection clause. Please attach the proposed SOW language.
- Finance, if we approve credits, we need a promo code/GL code so bookings are correctly tracked.

Aditya — please loop Marissa with the reduced ask ($20k credits) and highlight urgency (procurement deadline 11/12). I'll annotate the MAL form when you send the updated numbers.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth package (exec approval request)

Thanks Neha — understood. I'm going to tighten the ask to speed this up. Updated proposal for Marissa's review: 

- Promotional credits: $20,000 (down from $25k)
- Trial extension: 45 days total (customer is asking for full-cadence through Dec 31 — procurement insists on the extended window to validate season-end usage)
- Introductory discount: 30% on Q1 committed usage (instead of 50%), capped at $60k

Why this is still valuable: with the reduced credits and 30% discount we protect margin while keeping a compelling conversion incentive. Procurement needs confirmation this week (target sign by 11/12).

I'm attaching an updated SOW summary link and the MAL form for approval. If Marissa can approve these concessions, I'll send the updated SOW and ask procurement to route DocuSign.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: deal-summary.pdf, MAL-approval-form.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-11-03T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clearline trial — request for 45-day extension + growth package (exec approval request)

Aditya / team — I reviewed the ask and the numbers (DL-7845). I'm approving a one-time exception with the following conditions: 

Approved concession package:
- Promotional credits: $20,000 (apply as promo credit to pilot invoices; credits expire 90 days after conversion if not used).
- Trial extension: 45 days (final pilot end date 2027-12-31).
- Introductory discount: 30% on Q1 committed usage, capped at $60,000.

Conditions and next steps:
1) Legal must sign off on the SOW with the credit/clawback language — Legal has 48 business hours to review redlines once we share the updated SOW.
2) Finance to create a promo GL code and flag the opportunity in SFDC under deal DL-7845.
3) This concession is contingent on a signed conversion commitment (12 months) within 60 days after pilot completion.
4) Sales to capture a reference commitment in writing as a condition of the credits being issued.

Aditya — you have my signoff to move forward under these terms. Please route DocuSign and copy Neha and me on the final SOW. I'll notify RevOps to prepare accounting treatment.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
